title: make / let / have + do

guess.question: make、let 后面的动词为什么不带 to？

options.text: 它们是使役动词，后面固定接不带 to 的动词原形
options.feedback: 对！make / let / have 后面一律 sb do，加了 to 就错。
不对——时态不影响，现在时也一样说 Let him go。

options.text: 因为 laugh 和 go 是不及物动词
options.feedback: 不对——及物不及物都一样，比如 made me clean the room。

rule.rule: make / let / have 后面接 sb do（省略 to）；help 后面 to 可有可无；变成被动时 to 要还原
rule.formula: make / let / have + sb + do　help + sb + (to) do　被动：be made to do（to 要还原）

anchors.en: He was made to work ten hours a day.
anchors.zh: 他被迫每天工作十小时。
anchors.note: 被动时 to 要还原

trap.wrong: The boss made the workers to work ten hours.
trap.right: The boss made the workers work ten hours.
trap.why: make 后面要省略 to，加了 to 是高频错误。

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——记住：make / let / have + sb do，只有变被动时才把 to 找回来。

options.distractor: make sb 后面接动词原形

check.stem: Let me ____ (carry) the bag for you.

options.distractor: let sb 后面接动词原形

options.text: He was made to wait for hours.
He was made wait for hours.
options.distractor: 变被动时 to 要还原

options.text: He made to wait for hours.
options.distractor: 缺少 be 动词，且主动句应省略 to

options.text: He was made waiting for hours.
options.distractor: 被动后接 to do，不接 doing

check.explanation: make 变被动要还原 to：be made to wait。
